segments.label: 接触 1 / f1514
segments.notes: Falling fan of detached pointed shears/blades reaches target in one impact cluster; f1509 is overhead launch flare, not yet target contact.

segments.label: 接触 2 / f1586

notes: 対応名は推定。5本の下降鋏は1接触群、巨大鋏の閉鎖が2接触目。直接呼出し試作で、追撃分岐・通常入力は未接続。
